message:
The other day, we found ourselves in a bit of a scramble when a sudden storm rolled in. As the wind howled outside, I noticed my partner rummaging through our go-bags, pulling out our emergency supplies like a kid on Christmas morning. It was a bit of a smug ‘I told you so’ moment for me, having insisted we pack those bags weeks ago. 

As we huddled together with flashlights and snacks, I couldn’t help but feel a wave of relief wash over me. It’s those little moments that remind us how preparation can turn a stressful situation into something a bit more manageable. Have you ever had a moment like that? 😊
